desc: View-once unlock — media jisne use kiya uski apni private chat mein (reply); "s" se photo ka sticker
output_text:
❌ Kisi view-once photo/video/voice ke reply mein *.vv* likhein (photo ka sticker chahiye to *.vv s*).

💡 *Tip:* View-once par seedha koi sticker ya word se reply karein — bina .vv likhe khud-ba-khud yourself mein aa jayega.
steps: Kuch ghalat ho to bot *sahi tareeqa* khud batayega 💡
notes: 💬 Seedha *sticker* ya koi *word* se reply par bhi auto yourself mein jata hai
✨ *.vv s* = photo ka *sticker* bana kar bhejta hai
